info.name: Bank bootcamp
info.description: Run from top to bottom through http://localhost:8080. Each run creates new documents, so it can be repeated. The eight services plus MongoDB, Redis and Kafka must already be running. A top-up returns 202 before the wallet balance changes; the phone transfer and the cash-out succeed after yanki.wallet.result is APPLIED.
